description: Sell `amount` of `sell` for `receive` across a price range, like Cookiebox's /trade Zip tab: `from` and `to` are **receive per sell** (what one sold token fetches; `from` is the price nothing sells under, `to` the best). Whatever part of the range the market already beats is sold at once (in the pool, or through the router, never under `from`); the rest rests as a one-sided Cookiebox CLMM position that the Cookiebox keeper trails as the price moves through the range, paying each filled part — plus the LP fees earned — to your wallet, and never converting back. Omit `from`/`to` for a range from one price step past the market to 10% above it. `fee` (bps) picks the pool the order earns fees in; default is the pair's deepest pool, else the 0.25% tier. A pair with no pool at that fee gets one created, priced at `from`; an empty pool parked on the wrong side has its price moved (trading nothing). Owner-paid setup: the pool's and payout accounts' rent and any tick arrays the range spans (~0.002 COOK each), then `enable`, which delegates the position NFT to the order and pins the Cookiebox keeper as cranker (`cranker: "anyone"` leaves it unpinned, which a hostile cranker can exploit to hand most of it back unconverted). Several transactions; each is simulated first, and with an external signer each is handed back as an `intermediate` step — submit it and call again, the flow re-prices and continues (nothing is sold twice). `minStep` (default 1) is how many tick spacings the price must move past the edge before it follows. Refuses a hooked mint with no published extra-account list, a mint the CLMM won't pool, and an `amount` you don't hold, all before anything is sent. Stop any time with stop_zip. ZIP A POSITION YOU HOLD: pass `position` (its NFT mint) instead — a one-sided position infers the direction, one holding both tokens needs `sell`; on a position whose order is already running this repairs a `paused` order (tick arrays, payout accounts, NFT delegation) without stopping it. Simulates first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

amount.description: how much of `sell` to sell (UI units)

cranker.description: who may crank the order: omit for the Cookiebox keeper (recommended), "anyone", or a public key you run a keeper with

fee.description: LP fee the order earns, in bps (one of 25, 30, 100, 200, 400); default: the pair's deepest pool

from.description: the price nothing sells under, as RECEIVE per SELL (what one sold token fetches). Default: one price step past the market

minStep.description: tick spacings the price must move past the trailing edge before it follows (default 1 = as close as the pool allows)

position.description: instead of sell/receive/amount: a CLMM position you hold (NFT mint or position account) to zip, or whose paused order to repair

receive.description: mint of the token to RECEIVE, or "COOK"

sell.description: mint of the token to SELL, or "COOK". With `position`: the side of it to sell

to.description: the best price of the range, RECEIVE per SELL. Default: 10% above `from`

name: start_zip
title: Place a Zip order
